ActionNotAvailable.en-US: This feature is not available yet

CommandLineInvalid.zh-CN:
命令行参数无效。

Iris 命令行用法：
无参数：启动托盘；已运行时打开输入翻译。
--action <动作名称>：执行已开放动作（不接受数字）。
--translate <文本>：翻译完整文本。TranslateText 必须使用此形式。
--help 或 -h：显示帮助。
每次只能使用一种形式，文本作为一个参数传入。
CommandLineInvalid.en-US:
Invalid command line arguments.

Iris command line usage:
No arguments: start in the tray; if Iris is running, open input translation.
--action <ActionName>: run an available action (names only, no numbers).
--translate <text>: translate the complete text. Use this form for TranslateText.
--help or -h: show help.
Use one form per invocation and pass the text as a single argument.

Iris 命令行用法：
无参数：启动托盘；已运行时打开输入翻译。
--action <动作名称>：执行已开放动作（不接受数字）。
--translate <文本>：翻译完整文本。TranslateText 必须使用此形式。

每次只能使用一种形式，文本作为一个参数传入。
CommandLineUsage.en-US:
Iris command line usage:
No arguments: start in the tray; if Iris is running, open input translation.
--action <ActionName>: run an available action (names only, no numbers).
--translate <text>: translate the complete text. Use this form for TranslateText.
--help or -h: show help.
Use one form per invocation and pass the text as a single argument.

ErrorUnknown.zh-CN: 发生未知错误，详情请查看日志
ErrorUnknown.en-US: An unexpected error occurred. See the log for details

FatalUnknown.en-US: An unexpected fatal error occurred. Iris will exit:

HistoryClearConfirm.zh-CN: 确认清空历史记录？此操作无法撤销。
HistoryClearConfirm.en-US: Clear translation history? This cannot be undone.

HistoryCloseFailed.zh-CN: 历史窗口尚未完成关闭，请重试关闭。
HistoryCloseFailed.en-US: The history window has not finished closing. Please retry.

HistoryClosing.zh-CN: 正在等待历史操作结束…
HistoryClosing.en-US: Waiting for history operations to finish…

HistoryDeleteConfirm.zh-CN: 删除所选记录？此操作无法撤销。
HistoryDeleteConfirm.en-US: Delete the selected record? This cannot be undone.

HistoryEmpty.zh-CN: 没有符合条件的历史记录

HistoryEnabledHelp.zh-CN: 关闭后不再记录新的翻译；已有历史仍可查看和管理。
HistoryEnabledHelp.en-US: Turning this off stops recording new translations. Existing history can still be viewed and managed.

HistoryKeepFavorites.zh-CN: 保留收藏（只删除非收藏记录）
HistoryKeepFavorites.en-US: Keep favorites (delete only records that are not favorites)

HistoryKeywordError.zh-CN: 搜索词包含无效字符，请修改后重试。
HistoryKeywordError.en-US: The search contains invalid characters. Please edit it and retry.

HistoryMaxError.zh-CN: 历史记录数量须为 100 至 100000 的整数。
HistoryMaxError.en-US: The history limit must be an integer from 100 to 100000.

HistoryMaxHelp.zh-CN: 100–100000 条。降低上限不会立即删除历史，将在下次写入或取消收藏时修剪。
HistoryMaxHelp.en-US: 100–100000 records. Lowering the limit does not delete history immediately; trimming occurs on the next write or when a favorite is removed.

HistoryMaxLabel.zh-CN: 最多保留的非收藏记录数，收藏额外保留

HistoryMissing.zh-CN: 记录已不存在，请刷新列表。
HistoryMissing.en-US: This record no longer exists. Please refresh the list.

HistorySelect.zh-CN: 选择一条记录查看全文和全部服务结果
HistorySelect.en-US: Select a record to view the full text and all provider results

HistoryStorageError.zh-CN: 历史记录操作失败，请重试。
HistoryStorageError.en-US: The history operation failed. Please retry.

HistoryTranslated.zh-CN: 已按当前设置发送到翻译窗口
HistoryTranslated.en-US: Sent to the translation window with current settings

HistoryTranslateFailed.zh-CN: 暂时无法打开翻译，请重试。
HistoryTranslateFailed.en-US: Cannot open translation right now. Please retry.

IpcRejected.zh-CN: Iris 未接纳此命令，可能正在退出或忙于处理已有请求。
IpcRejected.en-US: Iris did not accept the command. It may be closing or busy with existing requests.

IpcUnavailable.zh-CN: 无法连接到当前用户会话中的 Iris，请稍后重试。
IpcUnavailable.en-US: Cannot connect to Iris in the current user session. Please retry later.

IpcUnconfirmed.zh-CN: 未能确认命令是否已接收。命令可能已经执行，请先检查 Iris 的状态；本次不会自动重发。
IpcUnconfirmed.en-US: Could not confirm whether the command was received. It may already have run. Check Iris before retrying; this attempt will not resend automatically.

LanguageNextStart.zh-CN: 保存后下次启动生效；不会自动重启或切换当前界面。
LanguageNextStart.en-US: Changes take effect on the next launch. Iris will not restart or change this session's language automatically.

LanguageRestartPending.zh-CN: 已保存的界面语言与本次运行不同，将在下次启动时生效。
LanguageRestartPending.en-US: The saved interface language differs from this session. It will take effect on the next launch.

MouseApplyFailed.zh-CN: 鼠标设置已保存，应用未完成。请重试鼠标监听。
MouseApplyFailed.en-US: Mouse settings were saved but not fully applied. Retry mouse monitoring.

MouseApplying.zh-CN: 鼠标设置已保存，正在应用…

MouseBeamLabel.zh-CN: 仅在文本光标下识别选区
MouseBeamLabel.en-US: Read selections only under a text cursor

MouseDragError.zh-CN: 拖动距离须为 2–50 的整数。
MouseDragError.en-US: Drag distance must be an integer from 2 to 50.

MouseDragLabel.zh-CN: 最小拖动距离（物理像素）

MouseExcludedLabel.zh-CN: 完全排除鼠标划词的进程

MouseExplanation.zh-CN: 显示图标时会预读选区，点击后翻译已读取的文本。关闭剪贴板恢复可能改变剪贴板内容。
MouseExplanation.en-US: Showing the icon reads the selection in advance; clicking translates that text. Disabling clipboard restoration may change clipboard contents.

MouseHideError.zh-CN: 图标停留时间须为 500–10000 的整数。
MouseHideError.en-US: Icon duration must be an integer from 500 to 10000.

MouseModeError.zh-CN: 请选择有效的鼠标划词模式。
MouseModeError.en-US: Select a valid mouse selection mode.

MouseReadFailed.zh-CN: 选区预读未完成，请重新选择文本。
MouseReadFailed.en-US: The selection could not be read. Please select the text again.

MouseToggleDescription.zh-CN: 切换鼠标划词的启用状态（默认未设置快捷键）
MouseToggleDescription.en-US: Enable or disable mouse selection (no default shortcut)

NetworkAddressNeedsCredentials.zh-CN: 代理地址已改变，请明确选择替换或清除凭据。
NetworkAddressNeedsCredentials.en-US: The proxy address changed. Explicitly choose to replace or clear credentials.

NetworkBypassDescription.zh-CN: 启用后，回环、私网、.local 和单段主机名直接连接；系统代理自身的例外规则仍生效。
NetworkBypassDescription.en-US: Connect directly to loopback, private, .local, and single-label hosts. The system proxy's own exceptions still apply.

NetworkChooseEndpoint.zh-CN: 请选择已保存的测试目标。

NetworkCleanupFailed.zh-CN: 测试清理未完成，请重试结束；再次清理不会重新发送请求。
NetworkCleanupFailed.en-US: Test cleanup is incomplete. Retry cleanup; it will not send another request.

NetworkConfigurationUnavailable.zh-CN: 网络代理配置暂不可用，请检查配置后重试。
NetworkConfigurationUnavailable.en-US: Proxy configuration is unavailable. Check the configuration and retry.

NetworkCredentialHint.zh-CN: 不会回填已保存密码。替换时不移除首尾空格；HTTP(S) 允许明确的空密码，SOCKS5 要求非空。
NetworkCredentialHint.en-US: Saved passwords are never filled in. Replacement preserves spaces. HTTP(S) allows an explicitly empty password; SOCKS5 requires a nonempty one.

NetworkDescription.zh-CN: 保存后，新请求立即使用当前网络设置；正在进行的请求会完成原有连接。
NetworkDescription.en-US: After saving, new requests use the current network settings. Requests already in progress finish on their existing connections.

NetworkEnding.zh-CN: 正在结束测试，等待实际请求与清理完成…
NetworkEnding.en-US: Finishing the test; waiting for the actual request and cleanup…

NetworkEndpointChanged.zh-CN: 已保存的测试端点已更改，请重新选择后测试。
NetworkEndpointChanged.en-US: The saved endpoint changed. Select it again before testing.

NetworkInvalidConfiguration.zh-CN: 网络草稿或已保存端点不可用，请检查配置。
NetworkInvalidConfiguration.en-US: The network draft or saved endpoint is unavailable. Check the configuration.

NetworkInvalidEndpoint.zh-CN: 该服务端点无效，请先在对应服务页修正并保存。
NetworkInvalidEndpoint.en-US: This endpoint is invalid. Correct and save it on its provider page first.

NetworkInvalidInput.zh-CN: 代理地址或凭据无效，请检查协议、主机、端口和输入长度。
NetworkInvalidInput.en-US: The proxy address or credentials are invalid. Check the scheme, host, port, and input length.

NetworkNoEndpoints.zh-CN: 尚无可测试的已保存翻译或百度 OCR 服务。
NetworkNoEndpoints.en-US: There are no saved translation or Baidu OCR endpoints available for testing.

NetworkResponseDisclaimer.zh-CN: HTTP 响应可能来自代理；有响应不代表 API 鉴权或业务可用。
NetworkResponseDisclaimer.en-US: The HTTP response may come from a proxy. A response does not prove API authentication or service availability.

NetworkSaveBlocked.zh-CN: 网络测试尚未结束，完成清理后才能保存或重新载入。
NetworkSaveBlocked.en-US: The network test has not finished. Complete cleanup before saving or reloading.

NetworkSystemDirect.zh-CN: 直接连接（系统代理例外）

NetworkTargetHint.zh-CN: 仅测试此端点的 HTTP 连通性，不验证 API 密钥、模型或业务。不会保存草稿。
NetworkTargetHint.en-US: Tests HTTP connectivity only, not API keys, models, or service operations. Does not save the draft.

NetworkTargetLabel.zh-CN: 测试目标（已保存的服务）

NetworkTimedOut.zh-CN: 连接测试超时，实际请求已结束。
NetworkTimedOut.en-US: Connection test timed out. The actual request has ended.

NetworkTransportFailed.zh-CN: 连接失败，未确认端点响应。
NetworkTransportFailed.en-US: Connection failed. No endpoint response was confirmed.

NetworkUrlHint.zh-CN: 支持 http、https、socks5；socks5 默认端口为 1080。切换模式会保留此处未保存的草稿。
NetworkUrlHint.en-US: Supports http, https, and socks5. SOCKS5 defaults to port 1080. Changing mode keeps this unsaved draft.

OcrCopySource.zh-CN: 截图 OCR 后复制原文
OcrCopySource.en-US: Copy source text after screenshot OCR

OcrCredentialDescription.zh-CN: 不回填已保存密钥。替换时须填写完整密钥对；空框不表示清除。
OcrCredentialDescription.en-US: Saved keys are never filled in. Replacement requires both keys; empty fields do not mean clear.

OcrCredentialError.zh-CN: 百度替换凭据须填写完整 API Key 和 Secret Key；本地服务仅支持保持或清除。
OcrCredentialError.en-US: Replacing Baidu credentials requires both API Key and Secret Key. Local OCR supports only keep or clear.

OcrEndFailed.en-US: Could not finish test cleanup. Please retry.

OcrEndpointError.zh-CN: 请选择有效模式和 HTTP(S) 地址；地址不能包含账号、查询或片段。
OcrEndpointError.en-US: Select a valid mode and HTTP(S) address without user information, a query, or a fragment.

OcrLayoutError.zh-CN: 请选择有效的文本布局。

OcrLocalCredentialDescription.zh-CN: 本地识别无需密钥；可保持现有状态，或保存后清除旧凭据。
OcrLocalCredentialDescription.en-US: Local OCR needs no keys. Keep the current state or clear old credentials on save.

OcrMissingSelection.zh-CN: 服务已不存在，请重新选择
OcrMissingSelection.en-US: Provider no longer exists; select another

OcrNotifySilent.zh-CN: 静默 OCR 复制成功后通知
OcrNotifySilent.en-US: Notify after silent OCR copies text

OcrPageDescription.zh-CN: 识别结果填入翻译窗口原文框，可编辑并按需翻译。
OcrPageDescription.en-US: Recognized text goes into the translation window's source field, where you can edit and translate it.

OcrProviderSelectionError.zh-CN: 请选择存在的主服务；备用服务须与主服务不同，也可选择无。
OcrProviderSelectionError.en-US: Select an existing primary provider. Choose a different fallback provider or none.

OcrSaveBlocked.zh-CN: 未保存：请先重试结束测试。
OcrSaveBlocked.en-US: Not saved: retry test cleanup first.

OcrTestDescription.zh-CN: 测试只验证连接或本机能力，不进行图像识别。
OcrTestDescription.en-US: Checks connectivity or local capability only; no image recognition is performed.

OcrTimeoutError.en-US: Timeout must be an integer from 5 to 120.

ScreenshotConfirmHint.zh-CN: Enter / 双击确认 · 右键清除 · Esc 取消
ScreenshotConfirmHint.en-US: Enter / double-click to confirm · Right-click to clear · Esc to cancel

ScreenshotConfirmOnMouseUp.en-US: Confirm selection when the mouse is released

ScreenshotCopyFailed.zh-CN: 截图已完成，但图片未能复制到剪贴板。
ScreenshotCopyFailed.en-US: Screenshot captured, but the image could not be copied to the clipboard.

ScreenshotCopyImage.zh-CN: 确认后复制截图到剪贴板
ScreenshotCopyImage.en-US: Copy screenshot to clipboard on confirmation

ScreenshotDragHint.zh-CN: 拖动选择区域 · Esc 取消
ScreenshotDragHint.en-US: Drag to select an area · Esc to cancel

ScreenshotHideWindows.zh-CN: 截图前隐藏 Iris 窗口

ScreenshotOpacityError.zh-CN: 请输入 0–0.9 之间的有限数值。
ScreenshotOpacityError.en-US: Enter a finite number from 0 to 0.9.

ScreenshotSettingsDescription.zh-CN: 保存后用于下一次截图，不改变正在选择的区域。
ScreenshotSettingsDescription.en-US: Saved settings apply to the next capture, not to a selection already in progress.

SelectionEmptyDescription.zh-CN: 关闭后仅显示提示，不打开翻译窗口。
SelectionEmptyDescription.en-US: When off, show a notice without opening the translation window.

SelectionEmptyLabel.en-US: Open input when there is no selection

SelectionHotkeyDescription.zh-CN: 读取当前选区并翻译；仅在确认复制安全时模拟复制
SelectionHotkeyDescription.en-US: Read and translate the current selection; simulate copying only when confirmed safe

SelectionOrderError.zh-CN: 请选择有效的读取方式。

SelectionProcessesDescription.zh-CN: 每行一个文件名，例如 app.exe；不支持路径或通配符。空白行忽略，清空列表表示不额外排除。
SelectionProcessesDescription.en-US: One file name per line, such as app.exe. No paths or wildcards. Blank lines are ignored; an empty list adds no exclusions.

SelectionProcessesError.zh-CN: 进程列表最多 256 项；每项须为 1–255 字符的文件名，不能含路径、控制字符或通配符。
SelectionProcessesError.en-US: Use at most 256 entries. Each must be a file name of 1–255 characters without paths, control characters, or wildcards.

SelectionProcessesLabel.en-US: Processes where simulated copy is blocked

SelectionRestoreDescription.zh-CN: 检测到外部新复制时保留新内容。关闭恢复后，模拟复制会改变剪贴板。
SelectionRestoreDescription.en-US: New clipboard content from other sources is preserved. Turning restoration off allows simulated copy to change the clipboard.

SelectionSafetyDescription.zh-CN: 仅对确认复制安全的控件模拟复制。不支持的控件可能无法读取选区。
SelectionSafetyDescription.en-US: Simulate copying only in controls confirmed safe. Selections in unsupported controls may be unavailable.

SelectionTimeoutDescription.zh-CN: 100–2000 毫秒；用于等待复制后的新文本，不包含准备和恢复耗时。
SelectionTimeoutDescription.en-US: 100–2000 milliseconds to wait for new text after copying; preparation and restoration time are separate.

SelectionTimeoutError.zh-CN: 等待时间须为 100–2000 的整数，请检查当前输入。
SelectionTimeoutError.en-US: Wait time must be an integer from 100 to 2000. Check the current input.

SettingsAnthropicV1Warning.zh-CN: 官方 SDK 已自动包含 /v1 路径，反代地址通常不需要以 /v1 结尾
SettingsAnthropicV1Warning.en-US: The official SDK already includes /v1. Reverse-proxy addresses usually do not need a trailing /v1

SettingsCloseFailed.zh-CN: 设置窗口尚未完成关闭，请重试。
SettingsCloseFailed.en-US: The settings window has not finished closing. Please retry.

SettingsCorruptedNotice.zh-CN: 设置文件已损坏，已重置为默认值并将原文件备份。
SettingsCorruptedNotice.en-US: The settings file was damaged. Defaults were restored and the original file was backed up.

SettingsExtraHeaders.zh-CN: 附加请求头 (格式: Name: Value 每行一个)
SettingsExtraHeaders.en-US: Extra request headers (one Name: Value per line)

SettingsFutureReadOnly.zh-CN: 配置来自更新版本，当前为只读模式。请使用匹配版本打开；保存和联网测试已禁用。
SettingsFutureReadOnly.en-US: This configuration is from a newer version and is read-only. Open it with a matching version; saving and network tests are disabled.

SettingsHaikuEffortWarning.zh-CN: Haiku 模型不支持 Effort，已自动清空
SettingsHaikuEffortWarning.en-US: Haiku does not support Effort; the value was cleared automatically

SettingsHotkeyCleanupFailed.en-US: Shortcut cleanup failed; retry is available

SettingsHotkeyReservedConflict.zh-CN: 快捷键冲突：与预留功能【{0}】重复

SettingsHotkeysDescription.zh-CN: 配置触发常用功能的全局快捷键。支持包含 Win 键的组合键。
SettingsHotkeysDescription.en-US: Configure global shortcuts for common actions. Combinations with the Win key are supported.

SettingsHotkeyStatusConflict.zh-CN: 系统冲突（已被其他程序占用）
SettingsHotkeyStatusConflict.en-US: System conflict (in use by another program)

SettingsHotkeyStatusSavedPartialFailed.zh-CN: 已保存，部分快捷键未应用（可重试）
SettingsHotkeyStatusSavedPartialFailed.en-US: Saved; some shortcuts were not applied (retry available)

SettingsHotkeyStatusSavedPending.zh-CN: 已保存，录入结束后应用
SettingsHotkeyStatusSavedPending.en-US: Saved; will apply when shortcut capture ends

SettingsIncludeStreamUsage.zh-CN: 流式 Token 用量统计 (IncludeStreamUsage)

SettingsListModelsFailed.en-US: Could not get the model list

SettingsLogDescription.zh-CN: 控制应用程序运行时输出的最小日志记录级别。
SettingsLogDescription.en-US: Control the minimum severity recorded in the application log.

SettingsShowStartupNotification.zh-CN: 启动时显示后台运行通知
SettingsShowStartupNotification.en-US: Notify when Iris starts in the background

SettingsStatusAutoStartRetryFailed.zh-CN: 重试开机启动设置未生效
SettingsStatusAutoStartRetryFailed.en-US: Startup settings are still not applied

SettingsStatusConflict.zh-CN: 保存冲突：设置已被其他操作修改，请重新载入后再次编辑
SettingsStatusConflict.en-US: Save conflict: settings changed elsewhere. Reload them before editing again

SettingsStatusFileError.en-US: Could not save the settings file

SettingsStatusHotkeysRetryFailed.zh-CN: 重试快捷键应用未完成

SettingsStatusPendingApplyFailed.zh-CN: 重试翻译服务应用未完成
SettingsStatusPendingApplyFailed.en-US: Translation provider changes are still not fully applied

SettingsStatusPendingApplyQuotaFull.zh-CN: 待应用的服务清理事项过多，请先重试未完成的待应用事项
SettingsStatusPendingApplyQuotaFull.en-US: Too many pending provider cleanup operations. Retry the unfinished operations first

SettingsStatusRetryingAutoStart.zh-CN: 正在重试开机启动设置…

SettingsStatusRetryingPendingApply.zh-CN: 正在重试翻译服务应用…

SettingsStatusSavedAutoStartPending.zh-CN: 已保存，但开机启动设置未生效（可重试）
SettingsStatusSavedAutoStartPending.en-US: Saved; startup settings were not applied (retry available)

SettingsStatusSavedAutoStartStillPending.zh-CN: 设置已保存，但开机启动设置仍未生效（可重试）
SettingsStatusSavedAutoStartStillPending.en-US: Settings saved; startup settings are still not applied (retry available)

SettingsStatusSavedPendingApply.zh-CN: 设置已保存，但翻译服务刷新/清理未完成（可重试）
SettingsStatusSavedPendingApply.en-US: Settings saved; translation provider refresh or cleanup is incomplete (retry available)

SettingsStatusSavedPendingApplyAndAutoSt.zh-CN: 设置已保存，但服务刷新与开机启动均未完成（可重试）
SettingsStatusSavedPendingApplyAndAutoSt.en-US: Settings saved; provider refresh and startup settings are incomplete (retry available)

SettingsThemeDescription.zh-CN: 选择应用程序的色彩主题模式。

StartupFailed.zh-CN: Iris 启动或清理失败，请稍后重试。
StartupFailed.en-US: Iris startup or cleanup failed. Please retry later.

StartupRunningInBackground.en-US: Iris is running in the background

TranslateBusy.en-US: The system is busy. Please retry later

TranslateInputPlaceholder.zh-CN: 输入文本，按 Enter 翻译…
TranslateInputPlaceholder.en-US: Enter text and press Enter to translate…

TranslateInputTooLong.zh-CN: 输入文本超出最大字符限制
TranslateInputTooLong.en-US: Input exceeds the maximum character limit

TranslateNoConfiguredProviders.zh-CN: 未配置任何可用的翻译服务，请前往设置配置。
TranslateNoConfiguredProviders.en-US: No translation providers are configured. Add one in settings.

Text_ca2e5cc0561d.zh-CN: 服务显示名称不能为空
Text_ca2e5cc0561d.en-US: The provider display name cannot be empty

Text_f3bbfa20ffbe.zh-CN: 超时时间必须在 5 到 600 秒之间
Text_f3bbfa20ffbe.en-US: Timeout must be between 5 and 600 seconds

Text_29ee8b1d8422.zh-CN: 最大输出 Tokens 必须为正整数
Text_29ee8b1d8422.en-US: Maximum output tokens must be a positive integer

Text_6124b5028ecd.zh-CN: 采样温度必须在 0.0 到 2.0 之间

Text_77beb03033cb.zh-CN: OpenAI 兼容协议必须提供 BaseUrl

Text_9d819d38d5cd.zh-CN: BaseUrl 必须为合法的 http(s) 地址
Text_9d819d38d5cd.en-US: BaseUrl must be a valid HTTP(S) address

Text_15eca5fee02d.zh-CN: ChatCompletionsPath 必须为相对路径且不包含查询或片段
Text_15eca5fee02d.en-US: ChatCompletionsPath must be a relative path without a query or fragment

Text_98de13c4b263.zh-CN: Anthropic BaseUrl 必须为合法的 http(s) 地址
Text_98de13c4b263.en-US: Anthropic BaseUrl must be a valid HTTP(S) address

Text_f842c928e8e3.zh-CN: Effort 必须为 low/medium/high/xhigh/max 或 null
Text_f842c928e8e3.en-US: Effort must be low, medium, high, xhigh, max, or null

Text_e8189e624897.zh-CN: Haiku 模型不支持 Effort 参数，请清空 Effort
Text_e8189e624897.en-US: Haiku does not support Effort. Clear the value

Text_93c96aec66da.zh-CN: 已启用的服务必须指定模型名称
Text_93c96aec66da.en-US: Enabled providers must specify a model name

Text_b9763286f171.zh-CN: 已选择替换 API Key，但尚未输入新 Key
Text_b9763286f171.en-US: API Key replacement is selected, but no new key was entered

Text_3a713e0a1fc2.zh-CN: 测试连接必须指定模型名称
Text_3a713e0a1fc2.en-US: A model name is required for the connection test
